buffs.description:
[Berserk Signal] Puts the selected target into an Excited State. This boosts their Attack, Attack Speed, and Energy Recovery Speed for 20 seconds. After 20 seconds, they go into a Weakened State. This lowers their Attack, Attack Speed, and Energy Recovery Speed for the next 20 seconds. 
Injecting a Stimulant during the Excited State will renew the Excited State's duration. Injecting a Stimulant during the Weakened State will remove the Weakened State.
